snippet.title: Waifu Bubble Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042550/Waifu_Bubble
